technical_requirements.framework: React 19 + Tailwind CSS + Radix UI + Lucide React + Framer Motion + Recharts

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Never use generic centered layouts or flat SaaS blue.
Maintain the dark oxide (#0D0D11, #121217) background with crimson violet (#8B0032) and rust bloom (#D35400) glows.
Ensure all buttons and inputs have explicit interactive states and high contrast on focus.
Every card must have internal padding (p-6 or p-8) and subtle 1px border with layered ambient shadows.
Do not use transparent background on header, dialog modals, or dropdowns — use heavy backdrop blur with bg-[#0D0D11]/80 or bg-[#16161E].
All interactive elements must carry the exact data-testid attributes defined above.
Use framer-motion for smooth entrance transitions, rotating conic-border effects, and interactive Talia chat typing feedback.
